name: quiz
description: Short multiple-choice comprehension checks so important things do not slip past: /quiz:session covers what happened in the current Claude Code session (security-relevant changes, decisions made on your behalf, loose ends); /quiz:project covers the gotchas of the repo you are in (rules in CLAUDE.md, reversed decisions in git history, setup traps). Wrong answers are recorded in a local, uncommitted file per project and retaken one per quiz; /quiz:review works through that list four at a time.
